title: Can I BEAT Gun King?
summary: Gun King (Steam early access, 'roguelite action game'): you are a king with a gun in a top-down arena, surviving swarms of chess-piece enemies (pawns, knights, bishops; kamikaze pawns strapped with explosives, fireball/grenade throwers). Modes: Survival, Quickplay, Wave. Pick a gun (pistol, shotgun, crossbow, machine gun), choose one of four exits, level up from kills and pick chess-pun upgrades. First run dies to 'checkmate' after 4:08 (248 gold, 390 kills, level 7); second run wins the level (660 gold, 1,143 kills, level 11).
rules: Real-time top-down twin-stick: move the king and shoot; guns: pistol, shotgun, crossbow, machine gun (limited magazine, reload).
Choose one of four exits/biomes (e.g. icy blue).

Enemies: waves of chess pieces chasing you; kamikaze pawns with ammo/explosives strapped on, ranged enemies throwing fireballs and grenades; contact deals damage (e.g. 25 of 100 HP). Dying = 'checkmate'.

Level-up upgrades (pick 1 of several): Pawn's Endurance (regen 1 HP every 5 s), Skewer (+25% reload speed, -5% fire rate), Bishop Pair (extra projectile, +20 spread, -35 damage), Pawn Race (+30% knockback), Reverse Opening (bullets bounce off first target), Wing Gambit (summon a pawn ally), aura dealing 20 damage to adjacent enemies, freeze (frozen enemies lose 10% max HP).
Gold and kill counters; end-of-run summary; unlocks at gold thresholds (next unlock at 375).
win_condition: Survive the level's waves (Quickplay level cleared on the 2nd run); Survival mode = last as long as possible.
